name: Seeed reTerminal E1001
description: 7.5 inch monochrome ePaper terminal, ESP32-S3, battery-powered. Speaks Tesserae's TRMNL BYOS endpoints once the device is flashed with TRMNL firmware.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware. Flash with TRMNL firmware, point the device's API URL at your Tesserae base URL, and pair via the access token shown in Settings -> Devices.
